summary: One-frame notice that a player's free-turn-based (FTB) request is blocked (born in the TWN_Hospital_Reception dialogue). Created by the per-frame update of ecl::ftb::ZoneSystem from modified eoc::ftb::ZoneBlockReasonComponent.

fields.name: PlayerId
fields.evidence: ecl::ftb::ZoneSystem update bg3.exe+0x1956170: `p = FUN_141956c50(...); *(short*)p = sVar8;` where sVar8 is the low 16 bits of a uint at +0x12C of the character (player id, 0 skipped). Creator bg3.exe+0x1956C50 writes 0. Live 1.

fields.name: Reason
fields.evidence: Same function: `*(char*)(p+2) = cVar3;` where cVar3 is the byte of eoc::ftb::ZoneBlockReasonComponent (SE: uint8_t Reason; 0 skipped, 2 only when an entity is null). Live 1.

open_questions: That +0x12C of the character is a player id is inferred from its use as a short key.
